text:
Before buying a phone, a hotel room or a restaurant meal, most people now read the stars and comments left by other customers, and many think that online reviews influence buying decisions. I agree with this view, since shoppers trust the experience of other buyers, although some reviews are unreliable.

To begin with, online reviews strongly influence purchases because shoppers trust the experience of other buyers. Star ratings and comments reduce the risk of a poor purchase. A traveller who sees that a hotel has a rating of four and a half stars from two thousand guests, for example, will probably book it rather than a similar one with a lower score. Reviews supply details that advertising does not, such as noise at night, the quality of service or the size of a room, and they come from people who have no reason to sell. Shops that have a high rating attract more customers, and platforms rank products according to ratings, which increases their visibility. Surveys show that most consumers read reviews before they buy.

However, fake or paid reviews can mislead, so careful readers check many sources. Some companies pay people to write praise or post false criticism of competitors, and a few customers write extreme comments because they are angry or have received a free gift. A reader who looks only at the average score may therefore be deceived. Sensible shoppers read several detailed reviews, look for repeated points and consider the number of ratings and the date. Platforms should detect and remove false reviews, and authorities can fine companies that cheat. Businesses must protect their ratings by keeping standards high and by responding politely to complaints, since public opinion online has become a major factor in their success.

In conclusion, I agree that online reviews influence buying decisions, but consumers should read them critically.

plan.think: Mở bài nêu người đọc sao và bình luận trước khi mua; agree.

Tin kinh nghiệm người mua khác: sao và bình luận giảm rủi ro; ví dụ du khách thấy khách sạn 4,5 sao từ 2.000 khách sẽ đặt hơn khách sạn tương tự điểm thấp; chi tiết quảng cáo không có (ồn ban đêm, dịch vụ, diện tích), từ người không có lý do bán; cửa hàng đánh giá cao thu hút khách, nền tảng xếp hạng; khảo sát: đa số đọc trước khi mua.

Đánh giá giả hoặc trả tiền có thể gây hiểu lầm: công ty trả người khen hoặc chê đối thủ, khách giận viết cực đoan, nhận quà; chỉ xem điểm trung bình bị lừa; đọc nhiều đánh giá chi tiết, điểm lặp lại, số lượng, ngày; nền tảng gỡ giả; cơ quan phạt; doanh nghiệp giữ chuẩn, phản hồi lịch sự.
